name: Cookie-Monster
prompt: There's trouble on Seasame Street! The Cookie Monster needs your help to find his cookies!
description:
The Cookie Monster has lost his cookies again!
Visit the web page and use your browser's developer tools to inspect the cookies. Look for a cookie named `Red_Guy's_name` and change its value to 'Elmo'. Reload the page to see if you can find the flag!

Good luck, and may the cookies be with you!

hints.title: Using your browser
hints.hint: Use your browser's developer tools to inspect cookies.

hints.title: Who is the Cookie Monster?
hints.hint: The Cookie Monster is a character on the show Seasame Street. His friend Elmo is Red.

solutions: Load the page the first time
Look for a cookie in your browser that is called `Red_Guy's_name` and change the value to 'Elmo'
Reload the page to submit the new cookie and obtain the flag
